title: As a Smash stan I am a little hesitant about all of these changes but...
transcript: Smash just posted an audition notice, which means we now have more information on some of the new characters coming to the musical. Now if you are not caught up, the musical shaping up to be very different from the TV show it is based on. You can pause to read the synopsis that we got before. But now we have more information on some of the character descriptions and there are some wild choices here. First up is Karen and Ivy, who were played by Carrie Butler and Robin Herder in the workshop, respectively. You'll also notice that Karen is the only role that is not listed as already cast, which makes sense because Carrie has said that she was a last minute fill in for the workshop and was not continuing with the production. These are the only characters from the TV show that are retaining their name, although they still seem pretty different from their TV show counterparts. In this version, Karen is a career ensemble member who is still waiting for her big break, while Ivy Lynn is the big Broadway star that they brought in to play Marilyn with Karen as her understudy. Karen is also listed as married to Charlie, who will meet later in the character descriptions, but that's actually the actor playing Joda Maggio, which is again very different from the show. Next we have Chloe and Anita. Chloe was played by Bonnie Milligan and Anita was played by Vanessa Williams in The most recent workshop, Chloe is the assistant director character, which I don't think has an analogue on the show, unless I'm misremembering. And Anita is like the Eileen type role, the twist here being that she was actually on Broadway as a dancer before becoming a producer, which as far as I can remember was not an element of the Eileen character. Next we have Nigel who is the director choreographer of the musical. He was played by Brooks Ashmanskis in the workshop cast and is this productions version of Derek, although again very different. I also think this character description is very funny because it is basically just Casey Nicola. Next is Tracy and Jerry who were played by Crystal Rodriguez and Alex Brightman in the workshop. They're basically this shows version of Tom and Julia but they are married and straight. Another almost completely new role is Susan, who was played by Kristen Nielsen in the workshop. She seems to be serving as like the acting coach of the production. And our final two new characters are Scott and Charlie, who were played by Justin Cooley and Casey Garvin in the workshops. Scott seems to be the Ellis of the show, although instead of being the intern he is the son of one of the investors. And lastly we have Charlie who seems to be playing the Will Chase role as the actor playing Joe Dimaggio, although in this version he is married to Karen, which is A big change from the TV show. So that is everything that we know about the smash musical so far. Let me know your thoughts. Do you like these changes? Do not like these changes. Personally, I wish they stayed closer to the TV show. But maybe that's just me.
